items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I'd take my lessons on the south side from W.L. Jackson. He had a music school over here.

ctx.x: Who did you study with or did you pick up the trombone yourself? Was that your first instrument?

No, I didn't pick up the trombone myself. In fact, my first love was the trumpet. I wanted, wanted a trumpet. But my family is very small. There's only about four of us in our immediate family. And my cousin is four years older than I am. So they wanted to start us to take in music at the same time. So he picked the trumpet. So it had to fall to me for the second choice. So my second choice was the trombone. I picked the trombone. And I, you know, stuck right with it. And my mother, it was quite a hardship on her…
